  children={"Get a Let's Encrypt certificate for a site"}
>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugin-api/web-servers/{hostId}/sites/{server}/{name}/certificate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs certbot with its nginx or Apache plugin for the site's domains and reloads the server when the certificate renews. A site made in the site form switches to HTTPS with it.
